jobs_results.title: Building Engineering Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Building Services... Engineering is a team of over 100 bright experts working in an international environment based out of offices in Madrid and Barcelona, and have completed projects across the globe.

We are looking to hire an inspirational Project Manager (Electrical or Mechanical background) to work closely with clients & architects and deliver upstanding construction projects.

For a successful performance in the role, you will need a strong technical knowledge in MEP engineering and previous experience of delivering large projects from concept design all the way through to tender stage.

We will offer you the opportunity to boost your career working with key stakeholders both nationally and internationally across the AECOM business.

This role is based in Madrid and you will have the flexibility you need for a work-life balance.

Job Responsibilities:
• To lead a team of MEP engineers, technical specialists to support the technical delivery of large building projects
• To actively participate in the development of the delivery team and ensure AECOM delivers the quality required to ensure a successful outcome for AECOM and our Clients.
• Be competent to deliver, review and approve engineering solutions
• Support on bidding opportunities and act as the technical team leader for projects, from feasibility through to handover.
• To identify change and where required liaise/support the project Commercial Manager with supporting technical justification for the change.
• To act as the main point of contact for MEP with design teams.
• Ensure financial targets and internal KPI’s are met including motivating others to contribute.
• To prepare and present designs, reports and specifications.
• Contribute to the update of AECOM standards.
• To grow Client and Architect relationships to support the continued growth of the business.
• To act as a mentor to junior staff, promoting CPD activities.
• To maintain and enhance expertise within the team and as an individual.
• To lead and support AECOM Net zero carbon strategy

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Degree educated in electrical or mechanical engineering or related discipline.
• Experience of seeing conceptual designs through to completion and dealing directly with clients.
• A highly motivated individual with excellent technical understanding of mechanical or electrical engineering along with a solid understanding of the requirements of other disciplines collaborating on multi-disciplinary projects.
• A track record of successful collaboration with design teams nationally and internationally.
• Ability to speak English fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations.
• Relevant experience in Building Services design, including areas such as specification writing, calculations, and developing designs from first principles and conversant with national/International codes and standards.
• Able to make decisions, act on their own initiative and operate in a pro-active way.

Additional Information

#LI-MG1

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $14.4 billion in fiscal year 2023. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs_results.title: CRM Specialist - Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Additional Locations: Poland-Warsaw; France-Île-de-France; Germany-Düsseldorf; Italy-Milan; Spain-Madrid

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN MILAN, MADRID, LONDON, PARIS, DUSSELDORF, WARSAW

Job Purpose

The role of the “CRM Specialist – Project Manager” has two major areas of responsibility:

i) make sure that the existing Salesforce.com (SFDC) solution is well implemented & adopted within the Urology division in EMEA and

ii) help our central headquarters to improve the tool taking into consideration our divisional... needs.

The CRM Specialist – Project Manager is expected to interact and communicate with other departments and roles: Marketing, Service, IT, Sales and Manager/Executive to ensure that the above two main objectives are successfully covered.

Main areas of responsibility
• Internal training. Responsible of the design and implementation of the required trainings that will ensure a successful adoption by each of the users within the division (over +100 employees). Plan and execute remote, face-to-face and one-to-one trainings with all SalesReps.
• Setup reporting standards. Define and create clear/intuitive content guidelines for SalesReps on “How to properly use and report in Salesforce” [FAQs website / Small-Videos / Pdf].
• Platform improvement. Help to improve the tool by formally submit ideas for new features and functions via user stories. These ideas should be collected within our division users. This objective includes: detect the idea, search for the consensus among the key players within the division, fulfill and submit the document, defend the requirement, test and validate the software, design and implement the launch of the new feature within the division. Work with business users and architects to define and document detailed user stories, process flows and data models.
• Data Quality (quantity). Make sure that all the different relevant sections in SFDC: contacts, accounts, opportunities, tasks… have an acceptable level of fields completed by each of the users. Proactively set data quantity KPIs, set expectations and put in place contra measures if need it (when the quantity of the data does not reach the standards required).
• Data Quality (quality). Make that the content data in SFDC has a high degree of quality, is reliable and consistent. Proactively set data quality KPIs, set expectations and put in place contra measures if need it (when the quality of the data does not reach the standards required).
• Massive data cleaning programs. Define and implement massive import/export processes on demand.
• First level technical & functional support. Become the first level support for all the members of the division. This included technical troubleshooting (technical problems of the platform) and functional lack of knowledge from the user. If problem cannot be solved, contact the second level support (European Cross-Divisional level).
• Enable feedback channels. Set up feedback channels to capture new ideas that will improve the SFDC platform. These tasks include actions as: be active in the SFDC chatter, create internal surveys, setup a network of ambassadors with in the division, organize regular calls and f2f meetings to capture ideas.
• Interact with daily sales business. In order to have a good understating of the business processes and priorate the needs, in a regular basis (once per month approximately), the candidate will need to be on the road with different SalesReps. That will provide a good visibility and understanding of the limitations and challenges the SFDC implementation faces.
• Knowledge and external training. Maintain a high level knowledge of system functionality, configuration, and process. Maintain industry relevant knowledge around product and industry trends
• Basic Administrator role. Create/Modify/Delete the permission of existing and new users
• Documentation. Maintain documentation on requirements: user stories, backlog, data models, triggers, and description on how each business function is using the object.

Knowledge, Skills and Ability Requirements
• English and German and/or French language skills is a must.
• Preferably a technical bachelor degree (Computer Science, Engineering…) or Management, Business Administration (or similar)
• Knowledge of Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) systems advantageous but not essential
• SAP knowledge is welcome.
• 2-3 years of experience in working for multinational companies.
• Be able to lead projects with deliverables, deadlines, and key milestones.
• Be able to lead technical discussions with stakeholders and internal teams.
• Effectively present ideas and product scope to internal audiences.
• Ability to work well with people including project stakeholders and project team members.
• Low travel requirements (once per month 2/3 days within Europe).
• Hybrid working model
• Strong analytical & technical skills
• demonstrated understanding of how to interpret SalesReps business needs and translate them into requirements.
• Self-motivated with great initiative attitude.
• Person with meticulous and detailed working skills.
• Common sense, pragmatic and hard worker.

Requisition ID: 578776

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you

jobs_results.title: Digital Project Manager (Shopify Development) with ITALIAN
jobs_results.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Rocket Digital we help companies grow, transform and enhance their digital strategy by creating brands, experiences and products that generate value in their customers. We work with personalized teams for each project, formed by the best specialized talents.

We carry out consultancy, data management, selection of channels, measurement of performance and attribution model. We offer experience and cross-channel technology. We work with full-funnel models, creating 360 degree strategies.

We focus on hiring the best people and empowering everyone to be better. Here you will find a young and ambitious team ready to change the way in which technology can help deliver better digital advertising across the world.

We are seeking a Digital Project Manager and Scrum Master with a passion for building products based on data for our customers. The ideal candidate will have some knowledge in each stage of product development process:
• UX Research & Design
• Software development... (CMS or custom made)
• Web analytics
• CRO

You don’t need detailed knowledge in any area (we have specialists in each area), but enough knowledge to lead other people from these areas. You will work with cross-functional team members and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.

Responsibilities

By partnering with cross-functional teams and customers, you will turn your insights into delightful products in a creative environment that requires proven leadership skills and the ability to execute a creative vision.

As a Project Manager at Rocket Digital, you will take part in:
• Analyze customer needs and write a scope for the project.
• Identify new product improvement opportunities.
• Analyze how a product satisfies market needs and consumer preferences.
• Stay up to date on current industry trends and market conditions.
• Lead teams in order to build new products.
• Keep customers informed of product development status.
• Modify and revise existing designs to meet changing customer preferences.
• Work closely with product engineers to suggest improvements for products and processes.
• Testing new products

jobs_results.title: Project Manager Instalaciones Mecánicas
jobs_results.description:
Somos WSP: ¡Únete a nosotros y prepárate para el futuro de tu carrera!

En WSP trabajamos ofreciendo soluciones personalizadas a las necesidades específicas de nuestros clientes, a través de una colaboración transversal entre diferentes sectores, y apoyándonos en la experiencia de nuestr@s expert@s en todo el mundo.

Cuando consideras un cambio profesional, es vital trabajar para una empresa que esté alineada con tus valores y objetivos, un lugar donde puedas encajar.

Descubre lo que representa WSP en 2024 y más allá...

¿Cuál es el rol?

Queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Project Manager Ingeniero/a Industrial, o Ingeniero/a Técnico Industrial con experiencia en instalaciones mecánicas, para liderar equipos de proyectos industriales, especialmente data centers, plantas de producción de baterías de Litio o componentes de baterías, industria farmacéutica y laboratorios.

Buscamos personas comprometidas, con ganas de aportar y crecer profesionalmente dentro de una... multinacional líder en el sector.

Tu Nuevo Rol, ¿Qué implica?

Entre tus funciones principales estarán:
• Liderar y gestionar proyectos desde la elaboración de las propuestas, siguiendo con la preparación, ejecución, seguimiento y cierre de los mismos.
• Actuar como “Subject Matter Expert” (SME) en lo relativo a instalaciones mecánicas para guiar y aconsejar a clientes y equipos de proyecto.
• Actuar como ingeniero/a líder de diseño en proyectos de ingeniería de instalaciones mecánicas en proyectos clave, supervisando al equipo de ingenieros del proyecto.
• Supervisar como “Quality Manager” cálculos de instalaciones, memorias técnicas, planos, especificaciones, mediciones y presupuestos, cumplimento de normativa y de los estándares de calidad establecidos en proyectos clave.

¿Qué estamos buscando incorporar al equipo?

Requisitos mínimos:
• Titulación: Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Técnico Industrial. Preferiblemente especialidad mecánica.
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia liderando y gestionando equipos de diseño en proyectos.
• Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando instalaciones mecánicas en proyectos industriales, de edificación, transporte o infraestructuras, desarrollando cálculos de dimensionamiento, elaboración de planos, redacción de especificaciones y estimación de costes.
• Desarrollo de propuestas técnicas y elaboración de ofertas económicas a clientes.
• Nivel de Inglés Avanzado C1

Requisitos deseados:
• Certificación PMP® del PMI® o similar, y/o experiencia en posiciones de PM.
• Experiencia en edificación industrial, especialmente centros de procesamiento de datos, farmacéutico, laboratorios y baterías, y particularmente desarrollados en un ámbito internacional.
• Conocimiento de software de modelado energético de edificios (Design Builder, IES VE, Energyplus, etc.)
• Conocimiento de software de certificación energética de edificios (HULC, CypeTHERM).
• Conocimiento de certificaciones y estándares de sostenibilidad aplicada a la edificación (Passivhaus, BREEAM, LEED, etc.)
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera ágil en un entorno dinámico, con continuos cambios y plazos ajustados, tanto en coordinación con equipos multidisciplinares como de manera autónoma.
• Persona proactiva y responsable con buena capacidad de comunicación.
• Desarrollo de proyectos en entorno BIM

Con nosotr@s encontrarás un equipo altamente profesional y multidisciplinar, dentro de una de las multinacionales de servicios de ingeniería más importantes del mundo y en el que tendrás oportunidad de participar en proyectos nacionales e internacionales así como colaborar con especialistas de diferentes geografías.

Contarás con un plan de carrera, formación continua y un proyecto de futuro.

Te ofrecemos unas interesantes condiciones laborales, buen ambiente de trabajo y flexibilidad horaria y modelo de trabajo híbrido que os ayude a conciliar la vida personal y profesional.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y sé el futuro de WSP!

• Actuar como “Subject Matter Expert” (SME) en lo relativo a instalaciones mecánicas para guiar y aconsejar a clientes y equipos de proyecto.
• Actuar como ingeniero/a líder de diseño en proyectos de ingeniería de instalaciones mecánicas en proyectos clave, supervisando al equipo de ingenieros del proyecto.
• Supervisar como “Quality Manager” cálculos de instalaciones, memorias técnicas, planos, especificaciones, mediciones y presupuestos, cumplimento de normativa y de los estándares de calidad establecidos en proyectos clave.

¿Qué estamos buscando incorporar al equipo?

Requisitos mínimos:
• Titulación: Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Técnico Industrial. Preferiblemente especialidad mecánica.
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia liderando y gestionando equipos de diseño en proyectos.
• Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando instalaciones mecánicas en proyectos industriales, de edificación, transporte o infraestructuras, desarrollando cálculos de dimensionamiento, elaboración de planos, redacción de especificaciones y estimación de costes.
• Desarrollo de propuestas técnicas y elaboración de ofertas económicas a clientes.
• Nivel de Inglés Avanzado C1

Requisitos deseados:
• Certificación PMP® del PMI® o similar, y/o experiencia en posiciones de PM.
• Experiencia en edificación industrial, especialmente centros de procesamiento de datos, farmacéutico, laboratorios y baterías, y particularmente desarrollados en un ámbito internacional.
• Conocimiento de software de modelado energético de edificios (Design Builder, IES VE, Energyplus, etc.)
• Conocimiento de software de certificación energética de edificios (HULC, CypeTHERM).
• Conocimiento de certificaciones y estándares de sostenibilidad aplicada a la edificación (Passivhaus, BREEAM, LEED, etc.)
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera ágil en un entorno dinámico, con continuos cambios y plazos ajustados, tanto en coordinación con equipos multidisciplinares como de manera autónoma.
• Persona proactiva y responsable con buena capacidad de comunicación.
• Desarrollo de proyectos en entorno BIM

Con nosotr@s encontrarás un equipo altamente profesional y multidisciplinar, dentro de una de las multinacionales de servicios de ingeniería más importantes del mundo y en el que tendrás oportunidad de participar en proyectos nacionales e internacionales así como colaborar con especialistas de diferentes geografías.

Contarás con un plan de carrera, formación continua y un proyecto de futuro.

Te ofrecemos unas interesantes condiciones laborales, buen ambiente de trabajo y flexibilidad horaria y modelo de trabajo híbrido que os ayude a conciliar la vida personal y profesional.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y sé el futuro de WSP!

jobs_results.title: Clinical Project Manager - Sponsor Dedicated - Anywhere in EMEA
jobs_results.description:
Clinical Project Manager

The Study Lead Country Operations (SLCO) is the primary point of contact for the Country Operations (CO) team at the global study level and will act as a core study team member. The SLCO will be accountable for coordinating and driving activities performed by country operations including start up, monitoring, site oversight, quality and specific study deliverables. The SLCO will, therefore, be involved in study documentation review, coordinating CO activities globally, and will act as a liaison for other key stakeholders for relevant site and monitoring issues at country level.

The SLCO be responsible for liaising with Country Operations personnel to conduct the feasibility process, providing feedback to the study team regarding potential site and patient numbers.

The SLCO is responsible for utilizing and interpreting data from analytic tools, in conjunction with country and regional intelligence to proactively identify risks to quality and compliance and... to develop and implement mitigation plans to address these risks.

The SLCO may be required to visit sites with the CRAs (CRO, FSP or in-house as applicable), or with other personnel (e.g. CO, Global Medical Affairs, etc.) for Sponsor Oversight, Inspection Readiness or Engagement Visits.

Job Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Accountable for
• Monitoring and site oversight globally assigned study(ies), representing the monitoring function on the Global Study Team
• Aggregation and communication of deliverables for assigned study(ies), globally, to the Clinical Program Lead (CPL)
• Resourcing and training of Functional Service Provider (FSP) CRAs for assigned study(ies) Validating local CRO resources, as necessary, to support execution of the study(ies)
• Developing and/or reviewing applicable study documents including training materials and reports
• Delivery of appropriate protocol and indication training to Country Operations teams
• Coordinationof start up and recruitment activities at the study level, across all countries
• Ensuring deployment of inspection readiness measures: including preparation of tools and required documentation

Responsible For:
• Liaison between Country Operations (CO) teams and the Global Study Team: act as the central point of contact for the CO team for assigned studies
• Standardization of study conduct and clinical monitoring proceses across study(ies)
• Collection of site nominations and communications thereof to the CPL
• Track trends occurring within the study that may impact other studies and communicate to the SLCO team and other key stakeholderes
• Together with the the SLCO team, standardize processes across the studies to improve efficiencies in CO activities
• Define monitoring requirements including components of Risk Based Monitoring (RBM)
• Support risk management and signal detection at a study level
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Sponsor Inspections by Regulatory Agencies or during audits
• Review quality metrics and provide solutions for continuous improvement
• Maintain a thorough knowledge of disease area and protocols

Essential Qualifications
• Extensive clinical trial experience across a range of highly complex disease areas
• Demonstrated capability of effective CRA and site oversight
• Solid knowledge of clinical development processes with strong emphasis on monitoring
• Track record of establishing effective relationships with investigator sites
• Ability to lead, troubleshoot and influence for quality and delivery
• A track record of ensuring GCP compliance and successful risk management of complex clinical studies is expected
• Ability to travel as required internationally and domestically. Demonstrates flexibility in schedule and willingness to travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in one of the disciplines related to clinical practice/health care, life sciences or drug development is required. A clinical or advanced degree (RN, MPH, MS, MA, MBA, PharmD) is preferred.
• 8+ years of clinical research experience in biopharma or CRO
• 4+ years of clinical project management wit regional or global scope
• Demonstrated project management skills across multiple highly complex clinical studies
• Experience of managing multiple studies including extensive experience in the management and oversight of CROs
• Experience of oncology clinical research is beneficial

We invite you to join IQVIA™
• Recognized by Great Place to Work as the second best company to work for (March 2019)
• FORTUNE Magazine's World's Most Admired Companies list for the third year in a row (January 2021)
• Recognized by the 2016 Scrip Awards as the Best Full-service Provider Contract Research Organization (CRO)
• Awarded the 2016 Eagle Award from the Society for Clinical Research Sites (SCRS) for the fourth consecutive year.
• A site-nominated award recognizing contract research organizations (CRO) and biopharmaceutical sponsors dedicated to building positive relationships with research sites through leadership, professionalism and integrity.
• IQVIA™ named in The International Association of Outsourcing Professionals (IAOP) 2017 Global Outsourcing 100® List which recognizes the world’s best service providers across a range of industries.

We know that meaningful results require not only the right approach but also the right people. Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and whatever your career goals, we are here to ensure you get there!

Are you interested or do you know the ideal candidate?
• If you know the right candidate or for more information on this role please contact ana.rey@iqvia.com
• Please note is necessary that your application is registered in our Talent Network (WorkDay) to process your candidacy

#LI-Hybrid #LI-AR4

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.description:
We are the Nestlé Nespresso SA Company and are proud to be one of the fastest growing operating unit of Nestlé. Our passionate, entrepreneurial-minded team has transformed Nespresso into the reference in portioned coffee and one of the world’s most trusted brands. Our growth comes from our commitment to research and development in order to pioneer and be the reference in the portioned coffee sector to provide the very highest quality coffees that could be enjoyed in the comfort of consumers' own homes and also savored at out-of-home locations, such as restaurants, hotels, offices and luxury retail businesses. We guarantee quality by taking a careful, thoughtful approach in how we source our ingredients, produce and market our premium coffee products. With corporate headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland, Nespresso is present in over 60 countries and counts over 12,000 employees worldwide. To learn more visit www.nespresso.com.

Position Snapshot

Nespresso

Location: Barcelona... Spain

Permanent Contract

Grade: G

Position Summary

Global eCommerce Project Manager-Team Lead is responsible for the Global Deployement Features, Services, Platform, B2C & OOH on Mobile and Desktop. He / She will work in close collaboration with the eCommerce Teams in Switzerland, Barcelona and on the Markets to plan and prepare the Global Deployement and ensure market support.

- Deploy the eCommerce Product roadmap deployment, prioritization, planning, in close collaboration with the Products manager and the DSU Partner

- Implement & Foster Agile ways of working together with the Digital Commerce Teams and Digital Service Units in Barcelona to execute roadmaps.(Strong Collaboration with the Global eCommerce Digital eXperience & Innovation Manager & Ecommerce Digital Products Manager)

- Management of the global eCommerce Deployment team (4+ project manager & 4 Webmaster) with the objective of providing a unique best-in-class Project delivery, including the best user experience across global eCommerce platforms and ensure that content & features are configured to be compliant, consistent and relevant for a seamless customer experience.

- Coordinate & implement continueslly enahnced processese including an Agile Approach.

Your responsibilities will be:

Excellent Project Management in the deployment available and future eCommerce platforms, features and services

Once an innovation pilot is deployed, the eCommerce Rollout team handles the enablement of markets in mid to large scale projects to ensure quality in delivery and clarity in the desired results. This team is comprised on Project managers, eMerchandizers/Webmaster to achieve industrialized approaches for decreased time to market on innovation in the Nespresso business model and the eCommerce eco-system more specifically.

- Excellence in project management to meet deadlines and ensure quality.

- Insights into deployment sequence in line with market needs.

- Alignment and coordination with IS Globe to secure Nespresso ambition.

- Coordination of content integration according to global guidelines and specific market needs.

eCommerce portfolio guidance to markets

The role is to lead a team to support markets, on Training and Best Pratctices.The support of markets aims to harmonize the approach across markets to best conduct an exemplary role in Project management and facilitate their own planning on annual cycles. This includes the drive a number of improvement projects to raise the level of new omni-channel and eCommerce enablers between pilot and industrialized deployment among the markets.

Reporting and communication to senior management and market leadership

In the role of eCommerce Portfolio Manager, regular communication and reporting on available eCommerce capabilities is produced to faciliate market organization and planning. This guidance comes in the form of the OMP and dedicated reporting sessions to Nespresso Zones and management to support achieving market sales opportunities through omni-channel and eCommerce channel objectives.

Strategic planning of available and future eCommerce OMP and Portfolio:

- Maintenance of HQ eCommerce OMP including monthly and weekly touch-points and action plans

- Deployment roadmap design and communication.

- Accountability in the deployment sequencing based upon rational criteria of potential business contribution.

- Contribution to and alignment of annual budget process vis-à-vis known market deployments programs and eCommerce OMP.

Portfolio management leadership in eCommerce innovation projects

- Ensures delivery of planned roadmaps in quality, time and budget, sssuring senior project management for market deployment facet of new innovation projects including drive of market activation guidelines.

- Dynamic budget forecasting and management for assigned resources

- Continual optimization of resources for HQ and market resources in line with new opportunities, such as Shared Services.

Develop People and Organisation

• Establish the appropriate organization in line with the operational plan (OP) and international guidelines

• Recruit, develop, motivate and manage a team to deliver superior performance and results

• Manage and comply with the HR and Line Manager’s Planning Cycle

• Manage the development and evolution of the eBusiness function in the Market/Region

• Ensure local eBusiness functions training capabilities

What will make you successful

Education:

- University Business (Commercial, Digital Marketing) degree

- Master Degree

Professional experience:

- Excellent competencies in project management (senior experience of multiples project/program 5+ years)

- Strong Leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset

- Strong expertise on Project Management

- Strong expertise in Digital technologies

- Strong Analytical Skills

- Excellent interpersonal & communication skills with comfort in speaking with Senior leaders.

- Demonstrated ability to think both strategically and tactically

- Ability to work in a multi-cultural & sites environment and build a sense of trust that creates a comfortable & effective workplace

- Brings a high-energy and passionate outlook to the job and can influence those around them

- Passion for innovation and “can do” attitude

- Proven excellence in Internet, eCommerce, mobile domain project management.

- Strong digital analytical and synthesis skills, knowledge of Analyitcs platforms.

- Understanding of the online acquisition activities and their impact on eCommerce sites.

- Understanding of Content Management Systems, workflows and optimizations.

- Strong knowledge in SEO optimization

Cultural experience:

- Proactive and solution-finding approach

- Distinctive skills in planning & prioritizing

- Business processes background

- Ability to identify and advice on an improvement action plan

- Good communication skills in English (fluent)

- Ability to work in a multi-cultural global organization

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description: As the Salesforce project manager, you will oversee multiple Salesforce-based projects for our team, providing day-to-day leadership to analyse their requirements, develop designs, and implement cloud-based solutions based on Salesforce and force.com platforms. In this position, you will be working collaboratively with a highly motivated Salesforce team.

Key Skills Required:
• Salesforce project management background.
• Detail-oriented with the ability to quickly assimilate, a willingness to learn new technologies, a proactive entrepreneurial spirit, and reliability.
• Strong team player with exceptional writing and communication skills.
• Willingness to travel to meet with client on-site and for internal meetings.

Areas of Responsibility:
• Be enthusiastic, professional, and confident while maintaining a strong focus for the team.
• Manage the overall client relationship, have full command of the client business model, and demonstrate respect and responsiveness to... client needs.
• Act as primary day-to-day point of contact for the client and the operational aspects of the project.
• Focused on building strong customer relationships.
• Monitor and manage project financial, scope, and schedule to ensure project stays on track for assigned client projects.
• Drive implementations of high-quality cloud solutions.
• Monitor project status and assess risk in process, people, and/or technology and adjust project plans to address accordingly.
• Assist in consultant team members in the delivery of client presentations during requirements, design, pilot and user acceptance testing sessions.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team before sharing with the client.
• Leverage a solid understanding of the Salesforce product suite in order to validate key design options and present proposal solution designs and implementations.
• Cultivate and manage highly functional teams comprised of company and client resources through all phases of the software development lifecycle.
• Provide mentoring, guidance, and general care to project team members

​Job Title: Renewable Project Manager

Location: Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain (Hybrid)

The Green Recruitment Company has partnered with a leading global energy consultancy firm in the search for a Renewable Project Manager for Owner's Engineering specialised in renewable energy projects.

The chosen person will be in charge of overseeing the technical aspects of renewable energy projects and ensuring compliance with standards and contractual obligations.
Key Responsibilities:
• Provide technical oversight throughout the project lifecycle.
• Ensure quality and compliance with specifications.
• Identify and mitigate project risks.
• Coordinate with stakeholders and manage vendors.
• Conduct technical due diligence and reporting.
• Stay updated on industry trends and best practices.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in renewable energy projects.
• Strong technical expertise in solar and/or wind projects.
•... Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluency in English and Spanish; additional languages valued.
• Willingness to travel as needed.

Join us on the frontlines of renewable energy asset management and be part of a team that is shaping the future of sustainable energy. Apply now and become a key player in our commitment to a greener world.

In conclusion, be part of an organisation to drive the renewable energy revolution and contribute to a sustainable future.
How to Apply:

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications and interest in the role to Catalina Fonrodona (c.fonrodona@greenrecruitmentcompany.com
